attr.title: Vengeful Guardian: Moonrider
attr.desc: Construct 2 / HTML5 build of Vengeful Guardian: Moonrider on a bundled aarch64 WPE WebKit runtime rendered straight to the framebuffer (mali-fbdev). Requires the user's own game assets. Tested only on Anbernic RG40xx H / muOS 2508.4 LOOSE GOOSE.
attr.desc_pt: Port do Vengeful Guardian: Moonrider (build Construct 2 / HTML5) rodando em runtime WPE WebKit aarch64 nativo, desenhando direto no framebuffer (mali-fbdev). Requer os arquivos do jogo do usuário. Testado apenas no Anbernic RG40xx H / muOS 2508.4 LOOSE GOOSE.
attr.inst: After installing the BYO package, copy the contents of your legitimate desktop/Electron game export to /roms/ports/moonrider/game/. Required: index.html, c2runtime.js, data.js, images/, media/, CSV files and the intro MP4.
